tagline: Leading marketplace for asset disposition and auction services globally
hero_kpi_rationale: GTV is a key metric measuring the total value of transactions conducted across the company's asset disposition platforms and marketplaces, reflecting operational efficiency and growth in transaction volume.

kpis.name: Gross Transaction Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions conducted through online auctions and marketplaces, private brokerage services, and other asset disposition channels
kpis.description: GTV represents the total proceeds from all items sold through the company's online auctions and marketplaces

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue from services and inventory sales
kpis.description: Total revenue includes service revenue and inventory sales revenue

kpis.name: Service Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from asset disposition and brokerage services
kpis.description: Service revenue represents a major component of the company's total revenue

kpis.name: Inventory Sales Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of vehicle and equipment inventory
kpis.description: Inventory sales revenue represents significant year-over-year growth

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income increases by 4% to $427.6 million

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA increases by 7% to $1.4 billion
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDA growth in line with revenue growth

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.713 Bn in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $2.04 in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.58 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.258 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 60.2% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Gross Transaction Value in 2025
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions conducted through the company's online auctions and marketplaces in 2025
kpis.description: GTV in 2025 reaches $16.2 billion, reflecting 2% year-over-year growth

kpis.name: Revenue Growth in 2025
kpis.explanation: Increase in the company's total revenue in 2025
kpis.description: Total revenue increases by 7% to $4.6 billion in 2025, driven by strong inventory sales growth of 18%
kpis.signal: Significant total revenue growth driven by inventory sales

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT systems risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the available excerpt, with detailed governance structure (Audit Committee, CISO, quarterly SSC), indicating active concern. Language remains descriptive rather than alarmist, but cybersecurity category weight is high by regulatory convention.

risks.title: Dependence on key interim executives (COO/CTO)
risks.score_rationale: Excerpt indicates that the COO is serving as interim CTO, signaling a vacancy at a strategic level. Although the language is factual, this situation creates concentration of responsibilities on a single individual, a new trend compared to a stable organization.

risks.title: Tax risk related to foreign shareholders (Canada)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the end of the document in the tax section, with cautious language ('no assurance can be given'). Risk is stable and governed by the Canada-U.S. tax treaty, but potential legislative changes could affect non-resident investors.

risks.title: Foreign control risk under Canadian investment law
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned mid-document, with neutral but precise language on ministerial approval requirements. Risk is stable and limited to control acquisitions, but represents a real regulatory constraint for RBA as a Canadian-listed company.

risks.title: Liquidity risk due to holding company status with no direct assets
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the dividends section, with direct language ('no material assets other than the shares of its subsidiaries'). This structural risk is stable but significant: dividend-paying capacity depends entirely on subsidiaries, creating vulnerability in case of operational difficulties.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of real estate assets in the United States
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned mid-document in the properties section, with descriptive language. Of 333 sites, 250 are in the United States, representing notable geographic concentration. Risk is stable, but a natural disaster or U.S. economic crisis would have a disproportionate impact.

ai_positioning.summary: The company RBA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
